# BriefLoop

> Local report workspace callable by shell-capable agents.

Published CLI/PyPI: {{pypi_version}}. Mac: {{mac_version}}. Windows: {{windows_version}}.
Python 3.11+. Install: python -m pip install --upgrade briefloop
Package: https://pypi.org/project/briefloop/

## External agent quick start

Use a user-selected workspace with an already running local BriefLoop service:

    briefloop external --workspace "/absolute/workspace" discover
    briefloop external --workspace "/absolute/workspace" skill
    briefloop external --workspace "/absolute/workspace" request --file request.json

Proceed when discover returns ready=true. It neither creates a workspace nor starts a service. Follow the installed skill for the exact request schema. Operations: inspect, source, submit, query, read, revise, export; download retrieves an exported Word file.
Submit runs asynchronously using the workspace-configured runtime/model and its account. Revise saves edits performed by the calling agent; preserve the complete rich document and base_version. Write retries reuse the exact request_id and body. A saved draft or downloaded working copy does not imply independent review or formal delivery passed.
This is a local CLI interface, not a remote MCP server. Read content may enter the calling agent's model context; keep credentials out of requests and logs.

- External agent guide: https://briefloop.ai/docs/external-agent.html
- English guide: https://briefloop.ai/docs/external-agent.en.html
- Agent Skill: https://briefloop.ai/agents/briefloop/SKILL.md
- Machine-readable discovery: https://briefloop.ai/.well-known/briefloop-agent.json
- Repository: https://github.com/Stahl-G/briefloop
- CLI source documentation: https://github.com/Stahl-G/briefloop/blob/main/docs/WorkBuddy外部入口.md
- Published versions: https://github.com/Stahl-G/briefloop/releases

Use the installed CLI's skill as the version-specific authority. Obtain user authorization for the task and chosen materials, preserve that authorization within scope, and do not repeatedly ask for already approved actions.
